services.observer: independently authenticated instrument; durable state transition journal; separate credential and control domain
services.source: registered frozen cohort; fixed source_id and source_digest; never generated by a memory conversation

rollback: disable new trials and deployment dispatch
reconcile unknown attempts with their original identities
run native safety recovery explicitly; report unresolved attempts until receipts confirm resolution
installation: Trusted deployment asset. Configure the services before the first Space load. This file describes the supported contract; it is not an executable runtime configuration.
